name: Real estate video prices from videographers' price lists
description: Published listing video prices of 125 US real estate videographers, photographers and photo companies in 24 metros, read from each business's own pricing page on 18 November 2026: video on its own and as an add-on to photos, photo-and-video packages, cinematic video, social reels, agent on camera and drone video, with length, turnaround, the home size tier, whether the video is filmed, the source URL and notes on comparability.
creator: October (october-ai.com)

changelog.change: First release: 125 price lists in 24 metros, each read from the business's own pricing page on 18 November 2026.

fields.name: metro
fields.description: The US metro area the business serves.

fields.name: business
fields.description: The videographer, photographer or company, as its site names it.

fields.name: url
fields.description: The pricing page the row was mainly read from.

fields.name: checked

fields.name: filmed_walkthrough
fields.description: true when the cheapest video is filmed footage of the property; false for a slideshow or animation of photos, a 3D-tour fly-through or aerial-only video; empty when unclear. Only true rows count in the medians.

fields.name: video_standalone_usd
fields.description: Cheapest listing video the page lists as its own service, in US dollars (notes say when it is unclear whether photos are required).

fields.name: video_addon_usd

fields.name: photos_and_video_usd

fields.name: cinematic_video_usd

fields.name: social_reel_usd
fields.description: Cheapest vertical reel or short social video that is filmed.

fields.name: agent_on_camera_usd
fields.description: Cheapest price listed for a video with the agent on camera; notes say whether it is an add-on or a full price.

fields.name: drone_video_usd
fields.description: Cheapest drone or aerial video price (0 = included in the cheapest video).

fields.name: video_length
fields.description: Length as the page states it.

fields.name: turnaround
fields.description: Delivery time as the page states it.

fields.name: tier_note

fields.name: notes
